title: Allen Stanford's Inner Circle: What Happened to Each of Them

lines.say: Allen Stanford got one hundred ten years. His inner circle went to prison too.
lines.show: Allen Stanford got 110 years. His inner circle went to prison too.

lines.say: His finance chief, James Davis, cooperated and testified. Five years. Laura Pendergest-Holt pleaded guilty to obstruction. Three years.
lines.show: His finance chief, James Davis, cooperated and testified. Five years. Laura Pendergest-Holt pleaded guilty to obstruction. Three years.

scene.title: Prison sentences
scene.src: Justice Dept., Jan 22, 2013 · Justice Dept. Fraud Section

lines.say: Accountants Gilbert Lopez and Mark Kuhrt were convicted at trial. Twenty years each. Bloomberg Law reports President Biden shortened Kuhrt's term in December two thousand twenty-four. Prison records list Lopez as released that month.
lines.show: Accountants Gilbert Lopez and Mark Kuhrt were convicted at trial. 20 years each. Bloomberg Law reports President Biden shortened Kuhrt's term in December 2024. Prison records list Lopez as released that month.

scene.src: Bloomberg Law, Sept 19, 2025 · Federal Bureau of Prisons

lines.say: Antigua's regulator, Leroy King, was extradited in two thousand nineteen. Ten years.
lines.show: Antigua's regulator, Leroy King, was extradited in 2019. Ten years.

lines.say: And in January two thousand twenty-five, the S.E.C. won a final judgment against Stanford, with a five point nine billion dollar penalty.
lines.show: And in January 2025, the SEC won a final judgment against Stanford, with a $5.9 billion penalty.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
